newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle moderate at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle moderate at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 3,200 slaughter steers and 1,200 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 58,000 head confirmed including 11,800 head or about 20 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1225 lbs 70.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs, mostly 1050 lbs 70.00.
